rapport_notes: Handled a Peloton concern with genuine care and honest information; patient throughout a call that dropped before completion.
process_discipline_notes: Call disconnects before the close/arrival-time confirmation is finished, so later-call discipline can't be assessed.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do you have any questions or concerns about the move that you would like answered on this call?" (asked before logistics probing)
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Peloton concern got real digging ('they may just have you sign a waiver... have you moved the pellet time before?... it eliminates the warranty'), but the glass-paneled-furniture concern only got a quick tie-in to damage coverage, not the same depth
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "you only pay for the time that they are there so if they do it in two and a half hours then you're good"

top_strength: Gave the customer genuinely useful, honest information about the Peloton's warranty risk rather than just reassuring her it would be fine — real trust-building expertise.
coaching_note: The glass-paneled bedroom furniture concern got folded into the damage-coverage recitation instead of a real follow-up (how many pieces, are they detachable) — the same shallow-treatment pattern seen elsewhere in this batch.
